Added specs/kanpan-prompted-commands.md: the design record for kanpan's `prompt` field and `MNGR_INPUT`, covering the urwid focus/input-handler split that routes keys to the prompt, why the target agent is captured at open rather than read at submit, why prompted commands need an executor separate from the shared refresh one, and why `prompt` combined with `markable` is rejected instead of implemented. It also inventories the `mngr label` limitations the feature inherits (no delete path, offline-host loss, wholesale label replacement on `--reuse --update`, CEL identifier keys) so they are not mistaken for regressions, and records batch prompting as the follow-up.
